description: Use an AWS S3 Tables table bucket as Iceberg Rest Catalog.
comment: S3TABLES_TABLE_BUCKET_ARN is a placeholder: the Test S3 Tables Catalog workflow fills it in with the ARN of the throwaway table bucket it created for the run. To use this config locally, point it at a table bucket of your own and make sure AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY / AWS_DEFAULT_REGION are exported for the credential chain to pick up.
on_init: CREATE SECRET IF NOT EXISTS s3tables_secret (TYPE S3, PROVIDER credential_chain); ATTACH IF NOT EXISTS '{S3TABLES_TABLE_BUCKET_ARN}' AS my_datalake (TYPE ICEBERG, ENDPOINT_TYPE S3_TABLES); Create schema if not exists my_datalake.default;
